description_en: Queries the status of protection features for website services
description_zh: 查询网站业务各防护功能的开关状态
name: DescribeWebCcProtectSwitch

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management. This parameter is empty by default, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh: DDoS高防实例在资源管理产品中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The domain names of website services. You can specify up to 5 domain names.
The domain names must have website configuration forwarding rules configured. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。最多可查询5个网站业务域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domains

ProtectSwitchList.description_en: The status of protection features for website services
ProtectSwitchList.description_zh: 网站业务各防护功能的开关状态

AiMode.description_en:
The mode of AI-based intelligent analysis. Valid values:
watch: Warning mode
defense: Defense mode
AiMode.description_zh:
AI智能防护的模式。取值：
watch：预警模式
defense：防护模式

AiRuleEnable.description_en:
The status of the AI-based intelligent analysis feature. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled
AiRuleEnable.description_zh:
AI智能防护的开关状态。取值：
0：关闭
1：开启

AiTemplate.description_en:
The level of AI-based intelligent analysis. Valid values:
level30: Loose
level60: Normal
level90: Strict
AiTemplate.description_zh:
AI智能防护的等级。取值：
level30：宽松
level60：正常
level90：严格
